candidates.draft_body:
Meqabyan (Ethiopian tradition) First Book of Meqabyan (Mäṣḥafä Mäqabyan I) (c. 600 AD)

'He who honors me, I will honor; he who loves me, I will love' — DIRECT CITATION of 1 Samuel 2:30 (the covenant-honor formula given by God to Eli the priest, prophesying the reduction of Eli's house). The verse functions in Meqabyan as the CONCISE COVENANT-FORMULA for the entire trilogy's theology: faithful witness (martyrdom-or-conversion) draws divine-honor; apostasy draws divine-disregard. The chapter as a whole develops God's renunciation of the house of Saul (vv. 1-6) leading to this formula at v. 7. The Tewahedo Liturgy of the Word recites 1 Sam 2:30 at the Trinity-Sunday and Royal-Lectionary offices.

Meqabyan (Ethiopian tradition) First Book of Meqabyan (Mäṣḥafä Mäqabyan I) (c. 600 AD)

Covenant-honor-formula deepening (paired with seed 30:7 1 Sam 2:30 covenant-honor): the verse develops the 'them that honor me I will honor, and they that despise me shall be lightly esteemed' formula. Patristic-extended-reception of 1 Sam 2:30: GREGORY OF NYSSA De Vita Moysis 2.260-262 (honor-and-dishonor parallels); JOHN CHRYSOSTOM Homilies on 1 Samuel; AUGUSTINE Enarrationes in Psalmos 30 + 70 (the honor-formula in Psalter); AMBROSE Letters 73 + 76 (the political application — Theodosius's penance + the Callinicum incident). The covenant-honor-formula parallels: PSALM 91:14-16 ('because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he hath known my name'); JOHN 12:26 ('if any man serve me, him will my Father honour'); ROMANS 2:6-11 (Pauline-divine-impartiality); SIRACH 3:6 (honor-father-and-mother formula echo). Tewahedo soteriology preserves the covenant-honor-formula as the canonical-anchor for Tewahedo-imperial-and-monastic confessional-tradition.

Tewahedo-Solomonic-dynastic-tradition (Kǝbrä Nägäśt 13th c.) preserves the covenant-honor-formula as the integrating-principle for Tewahedo-monarchic-history.
